description: Source file implementing preprocessing steps for Torch JIT interpreter graph, including inserting method calls, dropping unused values, and managing last uses of values within the graph.

classes.name: PreprocessGraph
classes.description: Class responsible for preprocessing a Torch JIT graph by inserting method calls, dropping unused values, and managing value lifetimes.

methods.name: insertEnterMethodCalls
methods.description: Inserts explicit __enter__ method calls after prim::Enter nodes in the graph.

methods.name: dropUnused
methods.description: Inserts prim::Drop nodes to remove unused values in the graph.

methods.name: insertLastUses
methods.description: Ensures every value has a final use in the same block where it is defined, inserting prim::Drop nodes as needed.
